2607.01225.title: Language-Critique Imitation Learning from Suboptimal Demonstrations
2607.01225.paper_summary: Prior work on imitation learning from suboptimal demonstrations typically relies on compressed supervision signals such as confidence estimates, discriminator scores, or importance weights. These scalar signals are inherently limited, as they cannot explicitly express intermediate reasoning about task progress, failure modes, or corrective actions. We propose a language-critique framework for imitation learning from suboptimal demonstrations that instead leverages natural language as a structured supervision signal, avoiding the collapse of expressive feedback into scalars. Our method first constructs language labels from demonstrations that explicitly describe current progress, identify suboptimal behaviors, and provide fine-grained corrective guidance. We then introduce a language-critique loss that directly trains policies using these structured signals without reducing them to scalars, and instantiate it for both behavior cloning and diffusion policies, yielding LC-BC and LC-DP. We further provide a theoretical result showing that the proposed objective upper-bounds the expert performance gap under standard assumptions. Empirically, we evaluate on diverse continuous control tasks spanning navigation, manipulation, and gameplay, where our methods consistently outperform strong imitation learning and offline reinforcement learning baselines. These results demonstrate that language can serve as a powerful and structured form of supervision for learning robust policies from suboptimal data.
2607.01225.paper_summary_zh: 先前針對從次優示範中進行模仿學習的研究通常依賴於壓縮的監督信號，例如信心估計、判別器分數或重要性權重。這些標量信號本質上是有限的，因為它們無法明確表達有關任務進展、中間推理、失敗模式或修正行動的內容。我們提出了一種語言評價框架，用於從次優示範中進行模仿學習，這種框架利用自然語言作為結構化的監督信號，避免將表達性反饋壓縮為標量。我們的方法首先從示範中構建語言標籤，這些標籤明確描述當前進展、識別次優行為並提供細緻的修正指導。然後，我們引入了一種語言評價損失，該損失直接使用這些結構化信號訓練策略，而不將其縮減為標量，並將其應用於行為克隆和擴散策略，產生 LC-BC 和 LC-DP。我們進一步提供了一個理論結果，顯示所提出的目標在標準假設下對專家表現差距進行了上界限制。在實證上，我們在多樣的連續控制任務上進行評估，這些任務涵蓋導航、操控和遊戲，我們的方法在這些任務上始終超越強大的模仿學習和離線強化學習基準。這些結果顯示，語言可以作為一種強大且結構化的監督形式，用於從次優數據中學習穩健的策略。
